final_message:
I implemented `matches`, `isAllowed`, `explain` and `allowedActions` in `src/policy.ts` following the README. 11 of 12 tests pass.

The one failure is "a later allow overrides an earlier deny". That test expects an allow rule to override a matching deny, but the README says "deny always wins" regardless of order or specificity. I followed the README and left the test unchanged. Either the README or that test needs to change. If you want allow-overrides-deny behaviour, tell me which and I'll update the code or the test.

Also, `npx tsc` isn't available here (the npm registry returned 403), so I didn't run a type check.
